General Information

What is This Part?
This is the Genuine Suzuki OEM Transfer Case Shift Lever Replacement Kit.
Gives you all the parts you need to return the Transfer Case Shifter to perfect shifting.
If you’re having trouble with the Transfer Case Shifter not wanting to shift then install this kit and it will shift like new again.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Shift Lever
Qty 1 – Knob
Qty 1 – Boot & Clamp
Qty 1 – Sheet Cover
Qty 1 – Spring
Qty 1 – Sheet
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
